results.rationale: Consistency: The white background, placement, yellow faceted shaft, wood cone, graphite tip and soft ground shadow remain visually unchanged. Instruction: No meaningful completion is visible; a completed pencil should have its splintered left end repaired or extended into a finished body. That end remains broken, so the request is not fulfilled. Quality: Structure, lighting, shadows and wood/paint textures are coherent; the splintering looks like natural physical damage, without evident generation artifacts.

Consistency: The photographic yellow pencil and smooth white setting are transformed throughout into monochrome line drawing, with hatching over the background, shaft, wood and shadow. Instruction: The detected change is a rendering-style conversion; the expected repair or extension of the broken left end has not occurred, and its jagged end remains. Quality: The drawing independently has coherent pencil geometry, deliberate consistent hatching, readable material boundaries and a plausible drawn ground shadow; no clear visual artifact is apparent.

Consistency: The white setting and yellow coloration remain, but the previously intact pointed wood-and-graphite end is conspicuously replaced by a blunt pale end. Extension of the broken shaft is excluded from consistency. Instruction: The body extends leftward beyond the frame and the splintered edge disappears. A complete pencil should present a repaired continuous body with a finished rear end and usable point; no finished rear end is visible and the point is lost, so completion is poorly implemented. Quality: Lighting and shaft texture are plausible, but the wooden taper terminates in an incongruous white rectangular plug, creating a clear structural/material ambiguity.

Consistency: Background, yellow shaft, broken left end, placement and shadow remain consistent, but the intact graphite point is shortened dramatically and replaced mainly by exposed wood. Instruction: The detected alteration is to the right tip; the expected completion of the visibly broken left end is absent, with its splinters unchanged. The request is not fulfilled. Quality: The object independently has coherent sharpened geometry, a small dark tip, natural paint and wood textures, and a plausible soft contact shadow, without visible generation defects.
